OSPS-AC-01.01.justification: The btclib-org organization requires two-factor authentication of every member and accepts only secure methods, not SMS. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/issues/1362#issuecomment-5903994882

OSPS-AC-02.01.justification: A new member gets read access, the organization's base permission. Every higher grant is assigned by hand. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/REPOSITORY.md

OSPS-AC-03.01.justification: The main-self-merge ruleset requires a pull request for every change to main. Its one bypass actor holds it in pull_request mode, which never allows a direct push. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#branch-protection-and-rulesets

OSPS-AC-03.02.justification: The main-integrity ruleset forbids deleting main and has no bypass actor. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#branch-protection-and-rulesets

OSPS-AC-04.01.justification: The default GITHUB_TOKEN is read-only at the organization and the repository, and cannot approve pull requests. Every workflow also sets permissions: contents: read at the top. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#tokens-publishing-scanning

OSPS-AC-04.02.justification: Every workflow sets permissions: contents: read at the top, and a job adds a write scope only where it uses it. zizmor's excessive-permissions audit runs in the required lint check. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#what-every-workflow-does

OSPS-BR-01.01.justification: No workflow uses pull_request_target or workflow_run. Event fields and inputs reach run: steps only through env:, and zizmor's template-injection audit in the required lint check refuses the unsafe form. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml

OSPS-BR-01.03.justification: Pull-request runs use the pull_request and pull_request_review_comment triggers, which give a fork no secrets and a read-only token. The review job, which holds a secret, runs only when the head repository is this one. On issue_comment, the mention job, which holds a secret on any pull request, checks out the default branch. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-claude-review.yml

OSPS-BR-01.04.justification: No workflow takes a workflow_dispatch input. A release tag's name is checked against the package version before anything is built. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml

OSPS-BR-02.01.justification: Each release has a unique calendar version (YYYY.M.D), set by a signed v* tag. release.yml refuses a tag that disagrees with the package version or is not on main, and PyPI never accepts a version twice. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/releases

OSPS-BR-02.02.justification: Every release asset carries the version in its file name: the sdist, the wheel, the CycloneDX SBOM and the attestation bundle. The attestation binds each asset to its digest. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/releases/latest

OSPS-BR-03.01.justification: Every official channel the project lists is served over HTTPS only: the GitHub repository, its issue tracker and advisories, and the documentation at https://btclib-node.readthedocs.io.

OSPS-BR-03.02.justification: Releases are distributed through PyPI and GitHub Releases, both HTTPS only. PyPI files carry PEP 740 attestations and the GitHub release a Sigstore bundle. https://pypi.org/project/btclib-node/

OSPS-BR-04.01.justification: The GitHub release body is RELEASE_NOTES.md's entry: what a user must act on, breaking and security changes included. CHANGELOG.md lists every change. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md

OSPS-BR-05.01.justification: Python dependencies come from PyPI, and the required test check runs the suite with uv from the committed uv.lock with --locked. pre-commit installs its hooks at the revisions .pre-commit-config.yaml names. Third-party actions are pinned by commit SHA. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#uvlock

OSPS-BR-06.01.justification: Every PyPI file carries a PEP 740 attestation from Trusted Publishing. The GitHub release carries a Sigstore build-provenance bundle over each asset's SHA-256. The tag is signed. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/releases/latest

OSPS-BR-07.01.justification: Secret scanning and push protection are on, so a push carrying a recognised credential is refused. The detect-private-key and detect-secrets hooks run in the required lint check. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/.secrets.baseline

OSPS-BR-07.02.justification: A secret is an environment secret only the owners reach, and any other store's entry is recorded in the spending repository's REPOSITORY.md. A secret is rotated when an owner changes or an exposure is suspected, and the list is reviewed yearly. btclib-org/.github's tests/secrets_test.py refuses an unrecorded entry. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/README.md#L2913-L2940

OSPS-DO-01.01.justification: The user documentation is docs/source/running_a_node.md, which README.md links, and the API reference at https://btclib-node.readthedocs.io/.

OSPS-DO-02.01.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md says where a defect is filed, and the bug-report form asks for what a report needs. SECURITY.md sends a vulnerability to a private channel instead. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml

OSPS-DO-03.01.justification: SECURITY.md gives the gh attestation verify command for the release assets, and RELEASING.md the check that rebuilds the sdist from its tag. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/SECURITY.md

OSPS-DO-03.02.justification: The verify command pins the signer: --repo names this repository, --signer-workflow the organization's reusable-build.yml (reusable-attest.yml for v2026.9.24, release.yml before it) and --source-ref the release tag. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/SECURITY.md

OSPS-DO-04.01.justification: SECURITY.md's *Supported versions*: only the latest release is supported, a fix ships as a new release, and nothing is backported. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/SECURITY.md

OSPS-DO-05.01.justification: SECURITY.md: only the latest release is supported, so a release stops receiving security updates when the next one is published. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/SECURITY.md

OSPS-DO-06.01.justification: pyproject.toml gives the reason for each runtime dependency. uv obtains them from PyPI and pins them in uv.lock, and Dependabot tracks them weekly with a seven-day cooldown. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#dependabot-and-pre-commitci

OSPS-DO-07.01.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md gives the build: uv is the only prerequisite, uv sync builds the environment from uv.lock, and uv build produces the sdist and wheel. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

OSPS-GV-01.01.justification: GOVERNANCE.md's Roles names who holds access to sensitive resources: the three owners, one of them the maintainer and the only bypass actor, each an administrator of every repository and a reviewer of the publishing environments. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles

OSPS-GV-01.02.justification: GOVERNANCE.md's *Roles* describes the maintainer, owners, repository collaborators, contributors, reviewers, the review bot, Dependabot and pre-commit.ci, and what each owes. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles

OSPS-GV-02.01.justification: Proposed changes and usage obstacles are discussed publicly in the repository's GitHub issues (with a question form) and pull requests; cross-repository questions go to btclib-org/.github's tracker. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/issues

OSPS-GV-03.01.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md explains the contribution process: one subject per pull request, the local gates, the review and the landing. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

OSPS-GV-03.02.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states what a contribution must meet: one subject, a Signed-off-by trailer on every commit, the gates CI runs, 100% line and branch coverage, and a review against REVIEWING.md. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

OSPS-GV-04.01.justification: A grant of write or admin, to any repository of the organization, is an issue in btclib-org/.github that states the reason, and an owner other than the one asking approves it there. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/GOVERNANCE.md#L44-L46

OSPS-LE-01.01.justification: main requires the lint / Sign-off check, which refuses a commit that lacks its author's Signed-off-by: trailer, Dependabot's and pre-commit.ci's aside. Web commits are signed off automatically. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/.github/scripts/check_sign_off.py

OSPS-LE-02.01.justification: The source code is under the MIT license, which the OSI approves. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/LICENSE

OSPS-LE-02.02.justification: The released wheels and sdist declare License-Expression: MIT, the same OSI-approved license as the source. https://pypi.org/project/btclib-node/

OSPS-LE-03.01.justification: The license text is the repository's root LICENSE file. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/LICENSE

OSPS-LE-03.02.justification: The LICENSE file ships inside every release asset: the sdist root and the wheel's .dist-info/licenses/. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/LICENSE

OSPS-QA-01.01.justification: The repository is public on GitHub at a static URL. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node

OSPS-QA-01.02.justification: Git history on GitHub records every change with its author, committer, date and signature; linear history and no force-pushes on main keep that record from being rewritten. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/commits/main

OSPS-QA-02.01.justification: pyproject.toml declares the direct dependencies ([project] dependencies, optional extras and dependency groups), and the committed uv.lock resolves and pins them. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/pyproject.toml

OSPS-QA-02.02.justification: Every release attaches a CycloneDX 1.6 SBOM generated from the built wheel, listing its dependencies and covered by the release attestation. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/releases/latest

OSPS-QA-03.01.justification: main requires the six CI status checks, up to date with main (strict). enforce_admins is off, so an admin merge without them is a manual bypass, which the control allows. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#branch-protection-and-rulesets

OSPS-QA-04.01.justification: The organization standard's section 2 (*Which repositories, and how far*) lists every repository of btclib-org and its tier, and the organization profile lists the published packages. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#which-repositories-and-how-far

OSPS-QA-04.02.justification: Each release is built from this single repository; the sibling packages it depends on are released separately from their own repositories, which are held to the same standard. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node

OSPS-QA-05.01.justification: No generated executable is committed. The only binary files are fuzz seed inputs and the Sphinx inventory python.inv.

OSPS-QA-05.02.justification: No executable, library or compiled file is committed. The only binary files are fuzz seed inputs under fuzz/corpus and docs/source/_inventories/python.inv, none of them code.

OSPS-QA-06.01.justification: test.yml's aggregate check ('test: every job passed') runs the test suite on every pull request and is a required status check on main. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/.github/workflows/test.yml

OSPS-QA-06.02.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md's *The environment and the gates* gives the command that runs the suite and which workflows run it on every pull request, on main and on a schedule, and which of them gate a merge. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

OSPS-QA-06.03.justification: The policy is 100% line and branch coverage (CONTRIBUTING.md, standard section 8). pyproject.toml sets fail_under = 100, so untested new code fails the required test check. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/pyproject.toml

OSPS-QA-07.01.justification: main's ruleset requires one approving review, but the maintainer's pull_request-mode bypass remains, and recent pull requests landed without a non-author approval. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#review

OSPS-SA-01.01.justification: ARCHITECTURE.md documents the components, their layering and every place the software reaches outside the process, and ASSURANCE_CASE.md's *Trust boundaries* and *Threat model* name the actors and what each can do. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md

OSPS-SA-02.01.justification: The API reference is generated from the docstrings of every public module, and tests/unit/docs_test.py fails when a shipped module is missing from it. https://btclib-node.readthedocs.io/

OSPS-SA-03.01.justification: ASSURANCE_CASE.md is the security assessment: what is claimed, the threat model, the trust boundaries and how each common implementation weakness is countered; SECURITY.md's limitations section records the known residual risks. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

OSPS-SA-03.02.justification: ASSURANCE_CASE.md's *Threat model* names the assets, adversaries and what is not defended, and *Trust boundaries* maps the attack surface where untrusted input enters, each argument naming the file, test or workflow behind it. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

OSPS-VM-01.01.justification: SECURITY.md gives the private reporting channels and states the timeframes: a report is acknowledged within 7 days, and a fix or a published advisory follows within 90 days. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/SECURITY.md#L19

OSPS-VM-02.01.justification: SECURITY.md names the security contacts: a private GitHub security advisory, or email to security at btclib dot org, which reaches the three organization owners. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/SECURITY.md

OSPS-VM-03.01.justification: Private vulnerability reporting is enabled, and SECURITY.md points to it (the Security tab's 'Report a vulnerability') and gives an email address as the alternative. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/security/advisories/new

OSPS-VM-04.01.justification: Vulnerabilities are published as GitHub security advisories on this repository, each naming the release that fixes it. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/security/advisories

OSPS-VM-04.02.justification: Each release's CycloneDX SBOM lists in its vulnerabilities array every vulnerability judged not to affect it, with the reason, from the tree's .github/vex.toml. None is judged so today, so the tree has no such file. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/README.md#L3120-L3135

OSPS-VM-05.01.justification: Every pull request runs actions/dependency-review-action, which fails on an added or changed dependency with an advisory of moderate severity or above, or with a licence outside the allow-list. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/README.md#L2892-L2909

OSPS-VM-05.02.justification: release.yml runs uv audit over every dependency the wheel declares before any publish job. An advisory, or a service it cannot reach, stops the release. The only exemption is an id the release's own signed VEX states as not affecting it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/README.md#L3149-L3160

OSPS-VM-05.03.justification: The Dependency review job runs on every pull request and is a required check on main (lint / Dependency review), so a pull request that violates the policy cannot merge without an admin bypass. Policy: https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/README.md#L2892-L2909

OSPS-VM-06.01.justification: The standard's section 5 sets the threshold at zero: ruff runs select = ALL, bandit's S rules included, and each finding is fixed or suppressed in place with a reason. zizmor holds workflows to the same. CodeQL alerts have no stated threshold. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#5-ruff

OSPS-VM-06.02.justification: The required lint check runs .pre-commit-config.yaml on every pull request (ruff with the S rules, strict mypy, zizmor, detect-secrets) and blocks the merge on any finding not suppressed in place with a reason. CodeQL also runs on every pull request but is not a required check. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/.github/workflows/lint.yml

access_continuity.justification: The organization has three owners, fametrano, giacomocaironi and pmazzocchi, each an administrator of this repository and a reviewer of its publishing environments. If one becomes unavailable, the other two can still close issues, merge changes and release. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity

accessibility_best_practices.justification: btclib-node has no graphical or web interface: it is a headless node driven by command-line options and JSON-RPC. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/README.md

assurance_case.justification: ASSURANCE_CASE.md states the threat model, the trust boundaries, the secure-design argument and the argument against common implementation weaknesses this criterion asks for. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

automated_integration_testing.justification: test.yml runs the test suite on every push to main and every pull request, and its aggregate job is a required check. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/.github/workflows/test.yml

build_non_recursive.justification: This tree builds no native binaries, so there is no recursive-build question to answer. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/pyproject.toml

build_preserve_debug.justification: No native build or installation step exists to strip or preserve debugging information. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/pyproject.toml

build_repeatable.justification: Pure-Python source is used directly (uv_build, no compilation step), so there is nothing whose bit-for-bit regeneration to test. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/pyproject.toml

build_reproducible.justification: The sdist is built with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH from the commit. sdist-rebuild.yml rebuilds the latest release's sdist from its tag and verifies it against the release's attestation, and RELEASING.md gives the same check. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/.github/workflows/sdist-rebuild.yml

build_standard_variables.justification: This tree builds no native binaries -- it is pure Python on the uv_build backend -- so there is no compiler or linker invocation for CC/CFLAGS/LDFLAGS to reach. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/pyproject.toml

bus_factor.justification: Almost every commit is the maintainer's. giacomocaironi's commits end in 2023, and two other people have landed one pull request each. Continuity rests on the three organization owners, each an administrator of this repository. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md

code_of_conduct.justification: btclib-org/.github's CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md is this repository's code of conduct, through GitHub's organization-wide default; the community-profile API reports it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md

code_review_standards.justification: REVIEWING.md states what a review checks, how a finding is written and what clears a pull request; the part shared by every repository is followed by what this tree checks in particular. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/REVIEWING.md

coding_standards.justification: pyproject.toml selects every ruff rule (select = ["ALL"]) with a documented ignore list, and runs mypy in strict mode. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/pyproject.toml

coding_standards_enforced.justification: ruff-check, ruff-format and mypy run as pre-commit hooks, and lint.yml runs the same .pre-commit-config.yaml in CI as a required check. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml

contribution_requirements.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states the coding-standard, lint-gate and 100%-coverage requirements a contribution must meet before it can land. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

contributors_unassociated.justification: The project has one significant contributor. giacomocaironi, an organization owner, wrote part of the original code, and two other people have contributed once each.

copyright_per_file.justification: Every source file under src/ opens with "Copyright (c) The btclib developers", e.g. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/src/btclib_node/__init__.py

crypto_algorithm_agility.justification: A node validates what the consensus rules define, and Bitcoin's consensus rules fix secp256k1, SHA-256 and the signature schemes. Another algorithm needs a soft fork first, and the project follows one when it activates. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/README.md

crypto_call.justification: The node reimplements no cryptography: it calls btclib, btclib-ecc and Python's hashlib and hmac.

crypto_certificate_verification.justification: btclib-node's p2p transport is not TLS-based (Bitcoin's wire protocol has no TLS layer), so there is no TLS support for this criterion to apply to. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md

crypto_credential_agility.justification: The RPC credentials are the cookie file and the -rpcauth entries, kept apart from the rest of the configuration and replaced without recompiling. The node holds no long-term private key. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/SECURITY.md

crypto_keylength.justification: BIP324 uses secp256k1 and ChaCha20 keys, which meet NIST's 2030 floor. The protocol fixes the key lengths, so no smaller key can be configured. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/SECURITY.md

crypto_password_storage.justification: -rpcauth credentials belong to the node's operator and the operator's own RPC clients, not to external users of a service. The node stores them as Bitcoin Core does, a salted single-round HMAC-SHA256, as SECURITY.md records. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/SECURITY.md

crypto_pfs.justification: BIP324 uses a fresh ElligatorSwift key pair per connection. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/SECURITY.md

crypto_published.justification: The node implements no algorithm of its own: it calls btclib and btclib-ecc, which implement published algorithms, and Python's hashlib and hmac.

crypto_random.justification: The BIP324 ephemeral keys, the RPC cookie and salts, and the P2P nonces come from Python's secrets module. Every other random value comes from the OS CSPRNG, through SystemRandom or os.urandom. Cluster linearization alone expands such a seed with Core's non-cryptographic xoroshiro128++, as Core does. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/tree/main/src/btclib_node

crypto_tls12.justification: btclib-node's p2p transport is not TLS-based (Bitcoin's wire protocol has no TLS layer), so there is no TLS support for this criterion to apply to. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md

crypto_used_network.justification: P2P uses BIP324 v2 transport, and v1 only with -v1transport=1. JSON-RPC is plain HTTP, bound to loopback by default. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/SECURITY.md

crypto_verification_private.justification: btclib-node's p2p transport is not TLS-based (Bitcoin's wire protocol has no TLS layer), so there is no TLS support for this criterion to apply to. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md

crypto_weaknesses.justification: No SHA-1 or MD5 appears under src/. The node uses the algorithms Bitcoin and BIP324 fix: secp256k1, SHA-256 and ChaCha20-Poly1305. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/SECURITY.md

dco.justification: main requires the lint / Sign-off check, which refuses a pull request with a commit that lacks its author's Signed-off-by: trailer. Dependabot's and pre-commit.ci's commits are exempt. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/.github/scripts/check_sign_off.py

delivery_mitm.justification: Distribution channels (GitHub, PyPI) use HTTPS exclusively.

dependency_monitoring.justification: Dependabot version updates cover uv and github-actions, and Dependabot security updates are on. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml

discussion.justification: GitHub supports discussions on issues and pull requests.

documentation_achievements.justification: README.md shows the OpenSSF Scorecard, Best Practices and Baseline badges together. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/README.md

documentation_architecture.justification: ARCHITECTURE.md documents the node's loop, its protocol and RPC surface, the transport, the chain state and store, validation, and what is delegated to btclib. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md

documentation_current.justification: The docs build is a required check (docs.yml, -W -n), and tests/unit/docs_test.py fails when a shipped module has no API page. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/.github/workflows/docs.yml

documentation_quick_start.justification: docs/source/running_a_node.md's Starting a node gives the install command and the command for each chain, and README.md links it. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/docs/source/running_a_node.md

documentation_roadmap.justification: ROADMAP.md, organization-wide in btclib-org/.github, covers the period until 2027-09-30, is reviewed every September, and states what is intended and what is deliberately not; this tree's README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md link it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/ROADMAP.md

documentation_security.justification: SECURITY.md's Limitations section lists what the node does not protect against: RPC credentials sent as plain HTTP, BIP324's lack of peer authentication, and the Alpha status. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/SECURITY.md

dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions.justification: The suite and the fuzz harnesses run without -O, so Python assert statements are active. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/.github/workflows/fuzz.yml

dynamic_analysis_unsafe.justification: This tree ships pure Python, a memory-safe language; it produces no software written in a memory-unsafe language for a dynamic memory-safety tool to run against. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/pyproject.toml

external_dependencies.justification: Every dependency is declared in machine-readable form in pyproject.toml's [project.dependencies] and dependency-groups, resolved and pinned in the committed uv.lock. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/pyproject.toml

floss_license.justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).

floss_license_osi.justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).

governance.justification: GOVERNANCE.md, organization-wide in btclib-org/.github, documents the decision model, the maintainer's bypass and every role a contributor, reviewer or owner holds; this tree's README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md link it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md

hardened_site.justification: The project site is served over HTTPS with Content-Security-Policy (frame-ancestors 'none'), X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Strict-Transport-Security. https://btclib.org/btclib-node/

hardening.justification: ruff's select = ["ALL"] includes the bandit S rules, so a hardening defect such as unsafe deserialization or shell injection fails the lint gate. CodeQL also runs on every pull request and every push to main. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml

implement_secure_design.justification: ASSURANCE_CASE.md's Secure design principles argues how each principle is applied, and its Trust boundaries covers the JSON-RPC listener and peer input. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

input_validation.justification: Peer input is checked at the transport before a handler sees it: a v1 header's length and magic, a v2 packet's length and authentication. Every block is checked against the consensus rules before it is accepted. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

installation_common.justification: The package is on PyPI, so `pip install btclib-node` (or `pip uninstall`) is the commonly-used convention for installing and removing it; README.md gives the exact command. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/README.md

installation_development_quick.justification: `uv sync` installs the whole development environment in one command; CONTRIBUTING.md's *The environment and the gates* section gives it beside `uv run pytest` and the lint gate. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

installation_standard_variables.justification: Installation is `pip install`, which follows pip's and the interpreter's own install-location conventions; there is no project-specific installer that could diverge from that convention. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/pyproject.toml

interfaces_current.justification: ruff's UP and FA rules flag deprecated constructs, and pytest turns every warning into an error. deps-latest and deps-oldest run the suite weekly at the newest and the floor versions. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/pyproject.toml

internationalization.justification: btclib-node generates no end-user text and sorts no human-readable strings; its output (hex, addresses, RPC results, log lines) is technical data. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/README.md

know_common_errors.justification: The primary developer wrote ASSURANCE_CASE.md's Common implementation weaknesses, which names each weakness and what counters it. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

know_secure_design.justification: The primary developer wrote ASSURANCE_CASE.md's Secure design principles, which argues how each is applied here. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

license_per_file.justification: Every source file under src/ states "Distributed under the MIT software license", e.g. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/src/btclib_node/__init__.py

maintenance_or_update.justification: Only the latest release is supported and nothing is backported (SECURITY.md). RELEASING.md runs griffe check against the previous tag, and RELEASE_NOTES.md lists what a user must act on to upgrade. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md

regression_tests_added50.justification: About 95% of the pull requests merged in the last six months that change src/ also change tests/. The 100% line and branch coverage gate also fails a fix whose new code no test runs. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged

release_notes_vulns.justification: v2026.10.8's notes name GHSA-74pj-5cgg-3m66, the advisory it fixes. v2026.10.4's notes describe its three fixes and link their issues, but do not name GHSA-rm5x-6v45-j8m6, GHSA-6hv4-mmgr-39wq and GHSA-68jv-ghr4-jjmj, published minutes after the release. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/releases/tag/v2026.10.8

repo_distributed.justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git is distributed.

repo_interim.justification: development is on the main branch of https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node

repo_public.justification: Repository on GitHub, which provides public git repositories with URLs.

repo_track.justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git can track the changes, who made them, and when they were made.

report_tracker.justification: Each repository uses its own GitHub Issues tracker for individual issues, with issue forms under .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/, and an organization-wide tracker in btclib-org/.github for cross-repository findings. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/issues

require_2FA.justification: The btclib-org organization requires two-factor authentication of every member. https://github.com/btclib-org

roles_responsibilities.justification: GOVERNANCE.md's Roles names the maintainer, the owners, repository collaborators, contributors, reviewers, the review bot, Dependabot and pre-commit.ci, and what each owes. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles

secure_2FA.justification: The btclib-org organization requires two-factor authentication and allows only secure methods: TOTP apps, security keys or passkeys, and GitHub Mobile, not SMS. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/issues/1362#issuecomment-5903994882

security_review.justification: pmazzocchi, an owner other than the maintainer, reviewed the project on 2026-09-30. The review pins its scope to a commit, checks each claim of ASSURANCE_CASE.md, states what it did not cover and files each finding as an issue. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/issues/1559

signed_releases.justification: Every PyPI file carries a PEP 740 attestation from Trusted Publishing, and each GitHub release a Sigstore provenance bundle. SECURITY.md gives the gh attestation verify command. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/releases/latest

sites_password_security.justification: Project sites are GitHub, PyPI and Read the Docs; this repository runs no site of its own that stores user passwords. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/SECURITY.md

small_tasks.justification: Small tasks for new contributors carry the label "good first issue", which CONTRIBUTING.md sets aside for a first contribution. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/issues?q=label%3A%22good+first+issue%22

static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities.justification: CodeQL's python analysis (codeql.yml) runs on a schedule, on every pull request and on every push to main, and ruff's `select = ["ALL"]` includes the bandit-derived S rules. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml

static_analysis_fixed.justification: No static-analysis finding has been confirmed as a vulnerability. The code-scanning alerts opened from 2026-10-04 on await triage: reusable-workflow calls at @main, test sockets bound to every interface, and one file-mode finding in dirlock.py. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml

static_analysis_often.justification: on every push and pull request: https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/actions/workflows/lint.yml, https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/actions/workflows/codeql.yml

test.justification: 100% coverage floor, enforced locally and in CI: https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/actions/workflows/test.yml

test_branch_coverage80.justification: pyproject.toml sets branch = true in the coverage configuration, so the 100% gate counts branches. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/pyproject.toml

test_policy_mandated.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires 100% line and branch coverage, and fail_under = 100 fails the CI gate on any new code without a test. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

test_statement_coverage80.justification: pyproject.toml sets fail_under = 100, gated on every pull request by test.yml. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/pyproject.toml

test_statement_coverage90.justification: pyproject.toml sets [tool.coverage.report] fail_under = 100, enforced on every pull request. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/pyproject.toml

tests_documented_added.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents the 100% coverage gate, so new functionality is not accepted without a test. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

two_person_review.justification: main's ruleset requires one approving review, but the maintainer's pull_request-mode bypass remains, and recent pull requests landed without a non-author approval. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#review

updateable_reused_components.justification: Reused components are either standard-library modules or PyPI packages pinned in uv.lock and bumped weekly by Dependabot, and the deps-latest sentinel runs the full suite against the upgraded set every week. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/.github/workflows/deps-latest.yml

version_semver.justification: Calendar versioning, YYYY.M.D, with the day as the micro level; each release is tagged v<version>. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github#12-releasing

version_tags_signed.justification: Every release tag is signed, and RELEASING.md reads each signature back. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/tags

vulnerabilities_critical_fixed.justification: No publicly known vulnerability is left unfixed: each published advisory names the release that fixes it. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/security/advisories

vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days.justification: No publicly known vulnerability is left unpatched. Each was fixed in a release within four days of being reported. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/security/advisories

vulnerability_report_credit.justification: pmazzocchi, who reported GHSA-rm5x-6v45-j8m6, GHSA-6hv4-mmgr-39wq and GHSA-68jv-ghr4-jjmj, is credited as finder on all three. GHSA-74pj-5cgg-3m66 credits no finder. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/security/advisories

vulnerability_report_response.justification: Every vulnerability report so far was answered and fixed within four days of being filed. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/security/advisories

vulnerability_response_process.justification: SECURITY.md's Reporting a vulnerability gives the private channels (a GitHub security advisory, or security at btclib dot org), who can see a report, and how a CVE is requested. Private vulnerability reporting is enabled. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/SECURITY.md

warnings.justification: mypy strict with all relevant extra checks activated, see https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/pyproject.toml

warnings_fixed.justification: warnings are not tolerated: mypy strict with all relevant extra checks activated, see https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/pyproject.toml

warnings_strict.justification: ruff runs with `select = ["ALL"]` (every rule family) and mypy runs with `strict = true`; both are required, zero-finding pre-commit hooks enforced again in the lint workflow. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-node/blob/main/pyproject.toml
